name: APIBreak-Replay
description: Public repositories that fixed a third-party API change by hand. SHAPI should flag the call site at the commit before the fix, and not after it. v1 adds instances mined automatically from public commits (scripts/mine.ts, 2026-10-31): Meta Graph API version bumps, and more GitHub workflow_dispatch and QuickBooks minorversion fixes, labeled from each commit's diff and pending a hand review. It drops voilalz/frontier-pulse, deleted from GitHub before it could be archived (P-07).
source: SHAPI commit mining of public GitHub commits, hand-verified on 2026-10-22; datasets/apibreak-v1-new.csv (mined)
